<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
from collections import deque
a = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
R, C = len(a), len(a[0])
# find player: orange cells
oc = [(r,c) for r in range(R) for c in range(C) if a[r][c]=='O']
print('orange cells:', oc)
# infer center: player 5x5, top-left (r0,c0) with r0%5==0, c0%5==4
r0 = min(r for r,c in oc); c0 = min(c for r,c in oc)
print('player top-left approx:', r0, c0)
center = (r0 + 2 if (r0+2)%5==2 else r0+2, c0 + 2 if (c0+2)%5==1 else c0+2)
# safer: center must be (r0+2, c0+2)
cr, cc = r0+2, c0+2
print('center:', (cr,cc), 'char:', a[cr][cc])
def walkable(r, c): return 0 <= r < R and 0 <= c < C and a[r][c] != 'c'
print('walkable (12,31):', walkable(12,31), a[12][31] if walkable(12,31) else '')
def bfs(sr, sc, gr, gc):
    q = deque([(sr,sc,[(sr,sc)])]); seen={(sr,sc)}
    while q:
        r,c,path = q.popleft()
        if (r,c)==(gr,gc): return path
        for dr,dc in ((-5,0),(5,0),(0,-5),(0,5)):
            nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
            if (nr,nc) not in seen and walkable(nr,nc):
                seen.add((nr,nc)); q.append((nr,nc,path+[(nr,nc)]))
    return None
p = bfs(cr,cc,17,16) + bfs(17,16,37,16)[1:]
dirs = []
for (r0_,c0_),(r1,c1) in zip(p, p[1:]):
    dirs.append({(-5,0):'UP',(5,0):'DOWN',(0,-5):'LEFT',(0,5):'RIGHT'}[(r1-r0_,c1-c0_)])
print('remaining moves:', len(dirs), dirs)
res = action(dirs[:8])
print({k: last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','done','level_completed','score','game_over')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
